node.title: Re: Any reason to use the Paws module over aws cli commands in perl script?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I feel dirty just executing command line commands in my perl script and it doesn't feel very professional

If you do it right, it's fine* - but backticks are usually not the "right" way to do it: [id://1180578]

In this case, see [jo37]'s and my responses to [id://11116518].

* Update: To be a little more specific: I personally think it's fine in the case of aws and other complex tools like that, and if you're not doing it in a tight loop where performance is important. For stuff like grep, cat, awk, etc., of course one shouldn't call external commands - [afoken] made a nice list in [id://1205217|this node].
